pm_exper_user_740_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some ways to make early mornings feel more peaceful and enjoyable?
pm_exper_user_740_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You might start by settling into your favourite armchair with some knitting and letting the click of the needles and the morning stillness set the tone for your day. Watching the light grow as your stitches take shape can be such a soothing way to begin before the bustle starts.
(b) You might start by finding a quiet corner of your home and letting the calm stillness help you gather your thoughts. Taking a few slow breaths and enjoying the gentle light can be such a soothing way to set the tone before the day begins.
(c) You might start by putting on a favourite jazz record and letting the mellow notes drift through the room as the morning light filters in. Listening closely as the music unfolds can be such a soothing way to ease into the day before the bustle begins.
(d) You might start by taking your coffee out onto the porch and letting the quiet of the morning and the gentle sea breeze set the tone for your day. Watching the light change and listening to the birdsong can be such a soothing way to gather your thoughts before the bustle begins.
